items.title: Apply now to be a European Climate Pact Ambassador!
items.description: You have until 31 October 2026 to submit your European Climate Pact Ambassador application. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis – so early applications are welcome!

items.title: Commissioner Jørgensen in Slovakia to discuss energy prices and security with Visegrad Energy Ministers and continue his Affordable Housing Tour
items.description: On Monday, 19 October, Commissioner for Energy and Housing Dan Jørgensen will be in Bratislava, Slovakia, to discuss high energy prices and security of supply with the energy ministers of the Visegrad Group (Czechia, Hungary, Poland and Slovakia).

items.title: Mayors meet with EU leaders in Brussels to advance affordable energy and climate resilience

items.title: Commission hosts a high-level policy dialogue on the role of forest-based value chains in the EU’s climate transition
items.description: Today, Commissioner for Climate, Net Zero and Clean Growth, Wopke Hoekstra brought together representatives of forest owners and the pulp and paper sector for a high-level policy dialogue on Europe’s forest-based value chains.

items.title: Steady progress on the One Europe, One Market roadmap

items.title: Cross-border gas network code – Commission launches call for feedback on revision of rules

items.title: Eurostat: EU oil imports value up by 56%, volume stable in Q2 2026
items.description: In the second quarter of 2026, the value of the EU’s petroleum oil imports rose sharply, by 55.8%, however their volume remained mostly stable compared with the monthly average in 2025, at 36.7 million tonnes (+1.2%).

items.title: Eurostat: Evolution of fuel prices in August 2026
items.description: In August 2026, the price of fuels and lubricants for personal transport in the EU increased by 23.8% compared with August 2025. This followed year-on-year increases of 13.7% in June and 16.9% in July.
